doc_friction.issue: No tool times the unwired-checks pool item by item; I wrote a scratch wrapper around unwired_checks.run_mixed(jobs=1). A --times flag on unwired_checks.py would save the next run that step.
Taken 2026-11-17, three days and many perf passes stale; it ranked suites that have since been worked on.

deviations.why: Where to look, step 2 (ci_profile.py over 600 runs): skipped it. The unwired pool runs inside every ventures-tests job and earlier notes pointed there, so a per-item reading of it was the more direct measure.
deviations.did: Timed all 267 pool items one at a time, before and after.
deviations.result: Found four scans with the same cause. Six pool items went from 37.0 s to 13.8 s run alone.

notes: Metric: wall seconds per item, run alone with bash time, warm cache, 4-core container, one run each. Before -> after: check_hidden_unicode 5.1->1.6, its test 5.9->2.6, check_third_party 11.6->4.3, its test 11.4->4.7, check_irs_table_figures 6.7->2.5, check_form_clobbering 2.6->0.8, its test 5.1->2.0 (48.4->18.5 s in all). Unwired pool timed item by item, serial: 368 s before (some contention from this run's own profiling scripts) -> 294 s after. Output: cmp identical for --list, --signals, --json (also at --min-hits 1), plus equivalence tests on every code point and seeded random strings. Local: run_workflow_locally --for-changes, 7/7 workflows passed (agent-cross-review and the deploy jobs cannot run locally). PR CI green.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: profile four checks, write and prove equivalent fast paths with tests, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
